subject: AcreetionOS Update — July 05, 2026
body:
The AcreetionOS continuous integration pipeline has seen significant enhancements recently, with the introduction of per-pipeline staging directories and the use of relative symlinks for the latest.iso file, ensuring a more stable and reliable ISO build process. This refinement is part of our ongoing effort to improve the overall quality of our distribution, and you can track these changes on our changelog page at https://acreetionos.org/changelog.html.

Development
The recent updates to our CI pipeline have been crucial in streamlining our build process, and we're committed to continuing this work to ensure that AcreetionOS remains a robust and efficient Arch-based distribution. Our use of pacman and the Arch repos allows for seamless integration of updates like the recent Emacs 31.1 release, which brings a multitude of improvements to this versatile editor. For more information on how to leverage these updates, visit our documentation page at https://acreetionos.org/docs.html.

Community
The AcreetionOS community has been buzzing with discussions around the latest software updates, including the Emacs 31.1 release and the recent stable kernel set. These updates not only enhance the user experience but also demonstrate the vibrant ecosystem surrounding our distribution. To stay up-to-date with the latest news and discussions, check out our wiki page at https://acreetionos.org/wiki.html, and for the latest ISO releases, head over to https://acreetionos.org/flash.html.
